t: Does The Direction A House Faces Matter?
s: August 11, 2020 - The worst direction for a home to face around here is south. That blistering Florida sun will be bearing down on you right when it’s at its peak. Of course this is localized advice. If you were planning on moving somewhere with a colder climate where you wanted to maximize heat you might turn this advice around and buy a south-facing home. Ultimately it’s not going to kill you to buy a house that faces towards the south or the west.
